system.description:
15th Level Clan Feature

As you reach the pinnacle of the Yamada clan, you have found that the absolutes they taught were merely limitations you’ve grown beyond.

By spending your Bonus Action as part of casting a Hijutsu you can use both your Ideal Cut and Tao abilities.

Once per turn, when making an Empty Blade attack, reduce the value needed to trigger its effect by 1.
